verdict.rationale: Reducto's Parse endpoint extracts figures/charts as part of structured output (reducto-docs-1), agentic mode explicitly supports 'advanced chart extraction' via custom prompts (reducto-docs-13, reducto-docs-38), and Citations attach bounding-box coordinates pointing back to source text for extracted fields (reducto-docs-11, reducto-docs-22), giving page/position traceability. However there's no explicit documentation of VLM-generated figure summaries or image-crop output format, nor independent confirmation that figure/chart citations specifically resolve to accurate bounding boxes. Missing for 10: explicit VLM figure-summary output examples, documented image-crop artifacts, independent verification of figure-level citation accuracy.
